body: P1 password-policy + anti-brute-force shipped (#2361 / #2365 / #2368 / #2371). Remaining ADR-0069 work (session-validation gate for password expiry + enforced MFA, plus P2/P3) consolidated into #2375.

### ✅ ADR-0069 fully implemented — P1 / P2 / P3 all merged

Closing this tracker. Every `(setting → enforcement seam → mechanism)` triple is wired with real runtime enforcement (ADR-0049 — no false surfaces).

**P1 — security floor**
- Breached-password rejection (HIBP, native) — the enforcement-wired template.
- Password complexity (min character classes) — `before`-hook validator.
- Password history (no-reuse) + expiry (`password_changed_at` + auth-gate posture).
- Account lockout + rate-limit tuning (`failed_login_count` / `locked_until`, sign-in hooks, admin **Unlock** action + endpoint).
- **Enforced MFA** — per-org `require_mfa` + grace period, across all surfaces (rest-server `enforceAuth`, runtime `enforceAuthGate`), with an objectui **remediation overlay** (enroll TOTP) that makes it end-to-end usable.
- The shared **session-validation gate** (`customSession` → `user.authGate`; rest + dispatcher seams) reused by password expiry and enforced MFA.

**P2 — defense in depth**
- Session controls: idle timeout, absolute max lifetime, concurrent-session cap (revoke = expire-in-place).
- IP allowlist (CIDR, trust-proxy extraction, fail-open on undetermined IP).

**P3 — federation**
- OIDC trust list (Okta/Entra/Auth0) — `register_sso_provider` + bridge (UI already existed; verified, no duplicate built).
- **SAML 2.0** via `@better-auth/sso` (#2404) — corrected the stale "SAML out of core" premise; no custom plugin.

All shipped across stacked PRs, each with unit tests + build + live dogfood + CI green before merge.
